head.trained_on: SINS dev training subset: 8920 clips x 4 channels, 257 sessions, all 4 folds; 9 demo sessions held out (data/meta/plan.json)

primary_metric: macro F1 over the 9 SINS activities (DCASE 2018 Task 5 metric), 10-s windows, with per-activity missed (FN) and false alarms (FP)

not_sure.rule: lowest θ with reweighted shown-label precision (macro over 9 classes) >= 0.90, channel 0

novelty.rule: 'Not sure' also when the sound's Mahalanobis distance to every activity is above the 99th percentile of dev clips (out-of-fold)

calibration.note: ECE in percentage points; temperature cross-fitted across folds so the 'after' number isn't fitted on itself

meal_activity.what: kitchen activity = cooking, washing up or eating (merged), per 10-s window, single mic

clap_probe.missing: only 2816 clips embedded and no seeded subset declared (cut)

leave_one_node_out.note: channel 0, reweighted, fixed C; train folds x 3 nodes -> test fold x held-out node

offlist.note: Every label shown here is wrong by construction (none of these are household activities). Wilson 95% CI.

published.caveat: Published systems scored all 72,972 eval clips and trained on all 72,984 dev clips with 4-channel posterior averaging; ours is a seeded, reweighted subsample with a head trained on <= 1,000 clips per class.

dcase2018_baseline.what: official log-mel CNN baseline, 4-mic posterior averaging

best_entry.note: tied at 88.4 unknown-mic with Tanabe_HIT_task5_1 and _4; the page lists no rank column

published.ranking_metric: macro-averaged F1 on the evaluation set, unknown microphones
